eventDescription:
Today, 3,000 seed balls were dispersed by the students of Triveni Academy in the Appur Hill Temple area.
These seed balls were prepared using seeds of various trees, fruit-bearing plants, and crops, including bamboo, tamarind, millets, guava, and sapota.
With the upcoming monsoon season in mind, these seed balls were dispersed with the hope that they will germinate and grow into trees, adding to the greenery of the hill region, promoting biodiversity, and contributing to environmental conservation.
